test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the selling price of an article if a shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 5% each on the marked price of ₹80.
solution:
**Given:**

Successive Discounts = 5%

Marked Price of an article = Rs.80

**Concept Used:**

Selling Price = Marked price × {1 - (d/100)}

**Calculation:**

After the first discount of 5%,

Selling Price = 80 – 5% of 80

Selling Price = 80 - (5/100) × 80 = 80 - 4 = 76

After the second discount of 5%,

The Final Selling Price = 76 – 5% of 76

Final Selling Price = 76 - (5/100) × 76 = 76 - 3.8 = Rs.72.20

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.72.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Calculation:

⇒ S.P = 80 × 95% × 95%

⇒ S.P = Rs.72.2

∴ The correct answer is Rs.72.20.
